lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in four to five roughly horizontal rows across the visible lateral flank, exhibiting a semi-regular grid distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated intensity that intersect the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating discernible grid-like anchor nodes across the mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal side and a localized shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the leading edge and mid-surface of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, high-contrast biological entities (Echeneidae) attached to the dorsal fin, ventral flank, and caudal peduncle.
